$comment: HAND-AUTHORED from v0125-devicedata.xml, transcribed element by element from the XML bytes - NOT produced by e142DocumentToJson (Rule 10, D-030). The E142-0225 R1-2.1 DeviceDataMap overlay, and the end-to-end exercise of the E138 PVSet shapes that JSON-FORMAT.md got wrong three ways at Task 5 and DEV-007 corrected at Task 7. All four are here: Arr as a positional ARRAY (of F8, and of Su, each Su itself a positional array of I2 - both recurse); a scalar carrying xsi:nil as JSON null, which is E138's way of saying a value is absent and applies to ANY kind; NoValue as an OBJECT because @reasonCode is use="required" and Description is its child - a bare null would lose both and warn on every document; and an empty Arr, which is [] and not absent. The Parameter list is the SCHEMA for the values: Table 19 makes the ordering a shall and the values carry no names of their own, which is why PVSet is a JSON array and why all four parameters are present and in order. A separate Sort overlay does the rendering - OverlayType is an xs:choice, so a DeviceDataMap overlay has no BinCodeMap and nothing to draw.
